result.title: EEG-Jev: A Unified Single-Pass Decision Model for EEG
result.summary: EEG analysis spans choosing alternatives, judging statements, and rating ordered attributes, requiring calibratable probabilities with explicit meaning. We present EEG-Jev, a unified single-pass decision model for EEG. Given an EEG window, a question and an answer specification, one forward pass returns a typed readout: CHOICE gives a candidate distribution, NOUL a proposition probability, and SCORE an ordered-level distribution and expectation. One checkpoint is trained jointly and evaluated once on held-out splits of 35 public sources. Core raw outputs reach 54.08% balanced accuracy on Stieger2021 motor imagery, 70.45% on Sleep-EDF-SC sleep staging, 72.11% per window at threshold 0.5 on CHB-MIT seizure detection with 0.825 AUROC, and 1.700 MAE on 0-10 ds005292 pain ratings. Prior correction and temperature scaling lower negative log-likelihood from 0.766 to 0.606 on Sleep-EDF-SC and 0.166 to 0.019 on CHB-MIT, while direct readout cuts batch-1 latency from 122.43 to 63.11 ms (1.94-fold) against a matched-backbone generative comparator. Interactive demonstration and aggregate results: https://neuroimglab.github.io/EEG-Jev/.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 EEG-Jev：给定 EEG 窗口、问题与答案规格，单次前向即输出带类型的读出（CHOICE 候选分布、NOUL 命题概率、SCORE 有序等级分布与期望），一个检查点联合训练并在 35 个公共数据源上评估，另做先验校正与温度缩放校准。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「单次前向直接读出＋概率校准」并与生成式解码对比延迟的做法，可能为 LVR 中内部状态如何被答案读出使用、单步停止与置信度校准提供参照，但属远领域且无视觉/多模态推理，需较多核查。
